cohort: 1134 male late adolescents in Tabriz, Iran
finding: Family history of asthma, atopy, exposure to secondhand tobacco smoke, active smoking, amount of automobile traffic around subjects' home, and keeping pets at homes were associated with asthma in late adolescent males, while time spent outdoors, parents' education, and delivery type were not.
mod_finding: Delivery type (normal vaginal delivery vs. C-section) was not associated with asthma.
